newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA C.BANK ONE-WEEK RATE RISES TO 53 PCT.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA C.BANK ONE-WEEK RATE RISES TO 53 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) said it raised the minimum permitted rate on its one- week refinancing funds to 53 percent from 51 percent last week.
Traders said the move failed to impress the money market which was flooded with lei and traded short-term funds at about 46 percent.

Some said the increase, which follows a rise to 51 from 49 percent last week, showed that the BNR was slowly tightening its monetary policy to shore up the battered leu currency ahead of expected pre-winter dollar hoarding.
The BNR's offer at Thursday's auction grew to 700 billion lei from a previous 500 billion lei.
